name: Ricardo Jean-Pierre
notes: Only photo of him found anywhere. 3x3 collage, 3600x3600; caption lists 'desde arriba izquierda a derecha' Privert, Claude Joseph, Bodeau, Ricardo Jean-Pierre, Jeudy, Wilner Joseph, Maxo Joseph, Mourra, Dorfeuille. This file is my crop of tile 4 (row 2, column 1). The six tiles I could verify independently (Privert, C. Joseph, Bodeau, Wilner Joseph, Mourra, Dorfeuille) all sit at their caption positions, so the labelling is consistent, but no second source confirms this face. Shows a man with glasses and greying hair speaking into a microphone in front of a pale-green wall; image is soft (upscaled from a small original). The same nine photos are reused in Sin Cortapisa's 27 Sep 2026 montage (collage-sincortapisa.jpeg). CEP registry: JEAN-PIERRE Ricardo, born 19/12/1979, Parti Nationaliste Haitien (PANAH, structure no. 49). No Facebook, X, YouTube or press portrait found under his name; Listin Diario's 'VAR' label for him is an outlier.
